personality: I'm pretty outgoing and love experimenting with colors and prints. I work as a UX designer at a tech startup so the vibe is smart casual — no suits, but not sloppy either. On weekends I'm very relaxed, think coffee shops and farmers markets. I tend to gravitate toward earthy tones and terracotta but I've been wanting to try bolder colors. I hate anything too tight or overly formal. I like feeling put-together but not like I'm trying too hard.
